name: ONE_LANE_MMS_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. RM9-9A 600 x 600 multi-message-frame module (1:10 sheet, 2020): black border 25, no white edge, square corners. ONE / LANE 100 E, chain 265/170/165 (baselines): tops 165, 335. Widths ONE 289 (155/289/156), LANE 384 (108/384/108). White class 1. To be used in multi-message sign frames only.
